_comment: The hand-curated worklist for scripts/import/adopt.ts — races goandrace.com
does not list, whose course file a human found and vouched for.
Committed for the same reason decisions.json is: each entry claims a
permanent public course slug (Rule 8) and records where that course's
geometry came from. routeSource 'organizer' is the one to prefer; a
'route-host' entry is user-uploaded geometry and wants a second look at the
rights before it ships. 'manual' means a person downloaded the file by hand
and routeUrl is a repo-relative path.
Adding an entry does not publish anything. adopt.ts writes a raw batch, and
parse -> qa -> promote run afterwards exactly as they do for a goandrace

races.name: Bend Marathon
races.routeNote: Linked as the marathon course file from the race's own course-info.html; AllTrails export carrying surveyed elevation. Retrieved 2026-08-17. Race confirmed still running — 2027 registration open on the organiser's homepage.

races.name: Heart of America Marathon
races.routeNote: Linked from the 'Map 2026' item in heartofamericamarathon.com's Course Overview nav — hosted on Google Drive rather than the organizer's own domain, but it is the file the organizer's own site links to as the current course. File is titled 'Heart of America Marathon (2021 and later)', single track, no elevation (DEM-filled). Measured 42.466 km before parsing. Retrieved 2026-08-18. Confirmed running 2026-09-07 via runsignup.com/Race/MO/Columbia/heartofamericamarathon.

races.name: Marquette Marathon
races.routeNote: marquettemarathon.com links a Google My Maps KML (mid=1m_PQ5y1PHAy7S-muKqewdkZBaMSk28sy) that bundles four routes in one file — Full Marathon Course, 1/2 Marathon, and two gravel-trail variants — so an automated fetch would need to merge unrelated tracks to use it directly. Hand-extracted just the 'Full Marathon Course' placemark (851 points) into a clean single-track GPX, saved at the routeUrl path (gitignored raw input, not committed). Measured 42.562 km before parsing, matching the certified distance. No elevation in the source (DEM-filled). Retrieved 2026-08-18. Confirmed running 2026-09-05 via marquettemarathon.com.

races.name: Staunton Rocks! Marathon
races.routeNote: Direct GPX linked from the organizer's own course page (gnarrunners.com), StravaGPX export, single track, real surveyed elevation throughout — no DEM needed. Measured 42.993 km before parsing. Verified live 2026-08-18 (200 OK, application/gpx+xml). organizer robots.txt has no relevant restriction. Confirmed running 2026-08-22 per gnarrunners.com/staunton-rocks.

races.name: Old Forge Marathon
races.routeNote: Organizer's course-maps page (trisignup.com/Race/OldForgeHalfMarathon5K/Page/coursemaps, run by Willow Running / Willow Health & Wellness Center) links a MapMyRun route (mapmyrun.com/routes/view/806208063) for the full marathon. MapMyRun's own robots.txt does not disallow the base /routes/view/ path or any file extension — genuinely permissive, unlike RideWithGPS/RunningAhead/plotaroute, all of which explicitly block automated access. The route's track (lat/lng/elevation, 1147 points) is embedded directly in the plain server-rendered HTML with no login required — verified by fetching the page directly. Hand-extracted the embedded points array into a clean single-track GPX (saved at routeUrl, gitignored raw input, not committed). Measured 43.046 km before parsing, real elevation present throughout. Retrieved 2026-08-18. Confirmed running 2026-09-12.

races.name: Montana Marathon
races.routeNote: Organizer's page (406raceseries.com/montanamarathon) links a MapMyRun route (mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6661112548) for the full marathon. Same permissive-robots.txt basis as Old Forge Marathon (see that entry) — track embedded in plain HTML, no login required. Hand-extracted the embedded points array (364 points) into a clean single-track GPX. Measured 42.123 km before parsing. Elevation is present throughout but was drawn by MapMyRun's own routing tool from a turn-by-turn route (street-name notes in the source data), not a recorded GPS track — treat with the same caution as a modelled/DEM source even though it is technically embedded 'gpx' elevation; worth a second look if this course's hills feel off. Retrieved 2026-08-18. Confirmed running 2026-09-20.
